api.abi_note: Developing service stats ABI grows; rebuild matching public/generated headers. Existing config/job-info/poll/scheduler-stats layouts and enum values remain. Tight byte caps must include the new preallocation.

behavior: Positive segment/month/rule-year budgets are global across all jobs in one PollBudgeted call; the existing WorkLimit caps queue/heap actions. Capacity0 advances calculations without publishing leases.

Heap/ready/query classes rotate across calls; search FIFO uses one-unit quanta. Eager charged probes leave the last segment/month unit for already queued queries; no-progress queries rotate once then defer.

SEARCHING with HasNext=false is nonterminal. Existing live leases/Data remain valid, Complete cannot retire it, Cancel removes its query without further traversal, and later faults preserve prior leases.

Initial service ADD reserves an unpublished bounded slot and computes through the same queue. Commit publishes an ID only after success. Mapping failure/close release the slot/zone and return original Data without body/job/retirement duty.
Provisional IDs are rejected by public Job/Cancel and never dispatch/reap. Kernel Jobs/PeakJobs include provisional reservations. FIFO command dequeue allows ticket replies to complete out of order.

Every owner turn uses Scheduler.WorkLimit for all three global recurrence limits, including when reserved completion output is full. Admission inspection is bounded by CommandWorkLimit before and after calculation.
LastPoll is a historical40-byte snapshot, not a live post-close queue gauge. Old synchronous Add/Poll remain available; mixing Poll into pending work gives up the recurrence-work bound.
costs: One additional416-byte typed query per configured job in the single kernel allocation, plus16 private header bytes and up to4 alignment bytes on verified x64 targets. BytesLimit charges the complete reserve; startup allocation/zeroing are real costs.

Query array is separate from unchanged240-byte hot job slots. Dense successors use a shared constant rounding/state/match probe charging one segment/month; an actual hit avoids full query initialization.

A miss seeds the initialized typed arena without repeating the charged lookup; normal advancement requests no heap, new lock, public opaque-context copy or extra zone retain. Pending queries retain phase/counter bookkeeping and zone/event matching costs.
Service LastPoll adds one mutex-protected40-byte update. Initial admission copies configuration/retains zone in existing bounded command/kernel storage; these ownership operations remain costs.

No new Core/runtime/dependency. Public opaque cursors still have their documented copies. Diagnostics, foreign clock/body callbacks, close/job scans, adapter cancellation/run scans and OS scheduling prevent a hard whole-owner CPU/P99 bound. No zero-overhead claim.

Provisional commit/abort/public-ID rejection/no dispatch before commit; independent later light admission; typed unknown mapping rollback under diagnostic OOM, with no job fault or retirement.

Query stays pending at the next actual clock boundary, progresses with no output reservations and returns Data/noJob on close. Old archived libraries fail this boundary on both platforms.
Deferred service unknown mapping fails with original Data/noJob/no body/retirement. Existing2048 warm service commands and all prior lifecycle/concurrent/cancel/overload/error tests remain.
